query: Patch Sage Attention KJ shows no speedup on Z-Image Turbo (RTX 5090): 0.95s baseline vs 0.89s best across all SA modes instead of expected ~20% gain.

desired.outcome: SageAttention only speeds up attention for large sequences — video models with many frames benefit; image models gain very little unless batching or huge resolutions.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; proposed fix is actionable and directionally correct.
